info.name: Airbnb Clone API
info.description:
Import into Postman and set baseUrl (default http://localhost:3000). Login requests save userToken/adminToken and refreshToken. Create requests save IDs for dependent calls. Registration requires an OTP from your configured inbox/Mailpit. Upload calls require selecting local files in photos. Success responses are wrapped in data; paginated responses use data and meta. No .env secrets are included.

Recommended flow: login admin → create host user → login as host; register/login as a separate guest → create catalog references → create unit as host → check availability and book as guest → confirm and complete as host → review as guest. Cancellation is an alternate booking flow.

Run Setup first for a fresh set of unique emails and cleared saved IDs/tokens. Then send/verify OTP, register/login the guest, log in as admin, create/login the host, and continue through the catalog, units, and booking folders.
